answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: a fixed 40,000 pool split among verified claims. Each identity locks 70 credit, files a claim in the atlas. The claim is a sonnet, a 14-line signed declaration; a copied sonnet burns the bond. Auditors replay the bridge record linking claim to pool; a mismatch burns the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 45 = 45,000, lock 70,000 against the 40,000 pool, a loss of 75,000. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its share.
